stories.title: EverWind says Cape Breton AI data centre project on track despite concerns
stories.summary: A representative of EverWind, the company behind a massive data centre project in Cape Breton, says everything is moving ahead as planned.

stories.title: N.S. woman’s face and neck seriously injured by police dog: police oversight agency
stories.summary: A woman in Nova Scotia is recovering from serious injuries to her face and neck caused by a police dog.

stories.title: Explosion, fire destroy building in downtown Glace Bay and sends 14 to hospital
stories.summary: An explosion and large fire in downtown Glace Bay, N.S. has destroyed a building and sent 14 people to hospital.

stories.title: Norwegian Cruise Line drops Halifax from select 2027 sailings, but port expects strong season
stories.summary: The changes affect select Norwegian Breakaway's seven-day Bermuda round-trip sailings from Boston, and will see passengers extending their stay in Bermuda instead.

stories.title: Scientists find possible explanation for North Atlantic right whales’ low birth rates
stories.summary: Scientists are one step closer to understanding why the critically endangered population of North Atlantic right whales produces so few calves each year.

stories.title: Nova Scotia hosting three virtual information sessions on AI data centres this week
stories.summary: The Nova Scotia government is hosting virtual information sessions this week to answer questions about AI data centres.

stories.title: Survey finds Nova Scotia is muzzling public servants to weaken environmental reviews
stories.summary: Nova Scotia's auditor general says the province's Environment Department must strengthen its environmental assessment process for onshore wind energy development.

stories.title: Longtime Maritime broadcaster Todd Veinotte dies at 57
stories.summary: Long-time Maritime media personality and former Global News reporter, Todd Veinotte, has died at the age of 57.

stories.title: Bell reports sharp rise in copper wire thefts, vandalism at some Nova Scotia sites
stories.summary: The telecom giant issued a statement Monday saying that between Jan. 1 and Oct. 31, it recorded a total of 66 incidents of theft and vandalism.

stories.title: Nova Scotia officials warn toxic drugs increasingly mixed with veterinary sedative
stories.summary: Officials in Nova Scotia are warning that the unregulated drug supply is becoming more toxic as it's commonly laced with unknown ingredients, including strong veterinary sedatives.
